hack.root_cause: Logic bug — referral reward claimMultiple() epoch not checked for reuse
hack.description: Level Finance is a BSC-based perpetuals platform. The exploit targeted the contract's function, which processed referral reward claims without checking whether the same epoch had already been claimed.
